notablePrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
description:
Gain any amount of life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.
